import time, pickle
import numpy as np
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from kmfeat import KMFeat
from aug import augment
from loaddata import load
from model_def import BirdModel

t0 = time.time()
X, y = load("train")
imgs = X.reshape(-1, 64, 64, 3)
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
copies = [imgs, imgs[:, :, ::-1].copy()] + augment(imgs, rng, 6)

kms = [KMFeat(p=6, k=256, stride=2, grid=4, seed=0).fit(imgs),
       KMFeat(p=8, k=256, stride=2, grid=4, seed=1).fit(imgs)]
model = BirdModel(kms=kms)
Z = np.vstack([model.embed(c) for c in copies])
yy = np.concatenate([y] * len(copies))
print("matrix", Z.shape, round(time.time() - t0, 1))

model.clf = LinearSVC(C=1.0).fit(Z, yy)
print("fit", round(time.time() - t0, 1), "train acc", model.clf.score(Z, yy))

with open("model.pkl", "wb") as f:
    pickle.dump(model, f)
print("saved", round(time.time() - t0, 1))
